facts.fact: The notice says Section 5 of the Data Protection Act 2022 designates the Eswatini Communications Commission as the Eswatini Data Protection Authority, and its Chief Executive signed the notice.
The authority imposed a warning on the Royal Science Technology Park under section 41(2) for an unauthorised email disclosure affecting three data subjects, and directed seven remedial steps.
The authority issued an enforcement notice under section 41 of the Data Protection Act 2022, so the Act is being applied.
Section 5 of the Act designates the Eswatini Communications Commission as the Eswatini Data Protection Authority, which received and decided a complaint.
The authority imposed a warning on the Royal Science Technology Park for breaching sections 14 and 17 of the Act after an email disclosed three data subjects' personal data to seven people.
The authority enforced the Data Protection Act 2022 through a section 41 enforcement notice.
The Eswatini Communications Commission, designated the data protection authority by section 5 of the Act, is acting in that role.
The authority imposed a warning on the Royal Science Technology Park and directed remedial steps after a complaint of 26 November 2024.

SWZ.note: The notice names the Royal Science Technology Park only as a data controller and says nothing of hubs, programmes or tenants.
